source_gap_producers_and_reused_proofs.meanPredict_regret_refined: Exclude zero by hT, instantiate BTL on interval with derived mean feasibility/optimality, subtract leader losses, bound first term by1/4, shift stability indices for tail, split sum and normalize denominators t+2.
